reasoning_content:
Wait — `web/core` is a composer package. But is `/workspace/web/core` a symlink, or an actual directory? Let me check. Also, the debug log is written inside the container (the web container is where drush runs, so the file lands in the container's filesystem — ddev syncs the project, but /tmp inside the container isn't visible from the host. I need to write to a path that gets synced. For example: /var/www/html/web/... no wait, the docroot is /var/www/html. The project is mounted at /var/www/html, which is /workspace on the host. So I'll write to /var/www/html/.batch_debug.log, which shows up at /workspace/.batch_debug.log.

Let me fix this.

action.command:
cd /workspace
sed -i 's|/tmp/batch_debug.log|/var/www/html/.batch_debug.log|' web/core/includes/install.core.inc
sed -n '1936,1938p' web/core/includes/install.core.inc
rm -f .batch_debug.log
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== BATCH DEBUG ==="
cat .batch_debug.log 2>/dev/null | head -50
